scope: Kuroki et al. 2021 article and author/institutional landing pages
DLR 2025 railway-refuelling manuscript and repository record
DOI and supplementary-data web search results
Kuroki et al. 2023 Energy Technology article and Wiley data-availability statement
search_recheck.finding: The public records confirm measurement-based validation context, but no downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logger, channel dictionary, or independent reuse terms were located.
search_recheck.action: Do not admit either lead as an external holdout. If needed, send the staged privacy-safe custodian request instead of repeatedly searching for a file that is not publicly exposed.

purpose: Record public leads that may contain synchronized HRS-to-vehicle measurements without admitting unverified material as validation evidence.

accepted_candidate_requirements: publicly identifiable source and persistent identifier
raw or de-identified common-clock station/dispenser/receiving-vessel channels
access and reuse terms suitable for independent scoring
not_admitted_as_validation: aggregate station inventories or pass/fail tables
article claims without a reproducible data file
data whose license or channel provenance is unresolved

candidates.title: Data-Driven Intelligent Analysis System for Monitoring and Anomaly Detection in Hydrogen Refueling Station
candidates.next_action: Use research/BAM_KETI_DATA_REQUEST_DRAFT_2026_10_10.md for a staged privacy-safe request: one schema pilot, three minimum events, then an eight-event frozen holdout if approved.
candidates.claim_boundary: The article and institutional description establish a credible lead and field-instrumentation context only. They do not by themselves provide a reproducible full-loop validation dataset.

candidates.title: NREL H2FillS supplemental HDVS Type-IV sample test
candidates.claim_boundary: Common-clock hose and seven-tank pressure/temperature/mass boundary; no station controller, cascade, ESD, nozzle/receptacle, vehicle protocol or full-loop claim.

candidates.title: Development, application and optimization of hydrogen refueling processes for railway vehicles
candidates.next_action: Request a de-identified machine-readable exemplar and channel/clock attestation from the corresponding project data custodian; keep the published figure as context only until that request is approved.
candidates.claim_boundary: The public manuscript shows a real railway refueling measurement example and useful channel roles, but a figure is not a reproducible synchronized station-to-vehicle holdout.

candidates.title: European Hydrogen Observatory public hydrogen refuelling-station inventory
reported_measurements: station location and public availability inventory
candidates.license_status: public dataset terms apply to inventory; no process-data reuse implied
candidates.next_action: Use only for station-scale/layout and pressure-class context; do not treat inventory availability as fueling-process telemetry.
candidates.claim_boundary: This is a public station roster, not a pressure-temperature-flow event dataset, and it cannot validate the digital twin or safety response.

candidates.title: Thermodynamic modeling of hydrogen fueling process from high-pressure storage tank to vehicle tank
candidates.channel_dictionary_status: model boundary described; public logger schema not located
candidates.license_status: article access and raw-data reuse terms require custodian confirmation
candidates.next_action: Request the de-identified validation traces, channel dictionary and permission for independent scoring; retain the article as methodological context only until the raw export is verified.
candidates.claim_boundary: The article reports validation against an actual fueling station, but the publication alone is not a reproducible full-loop holdout for this project.

candidates.title: Temperature Rise on Liner Surfaces of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Tanks during Fueling Process
candidates.channel_dictionary_status: article-level channel roles and conditions reported; machine-readable logger schema not public
candidates.license_status: article access is public; raw measurement reuse and redistribution are not granted
candidates.next_action: Request a de-identified common-clock trace, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and independent-scoring permission from the data custodian; keep article figures and endpoint values as context only.
candidates.claim_boundary: The article provides a high-value real-station tank thermal measurement lead. Its explicit data-availability statement says the research data are not shared, so it cannot be admitted as a reproducible full-loop holdout or used for parameter fitting.

decision.reason: No newly found candidate currently exposes a reproducible, licensed, synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace with channel provenance.
decision.minimum_next_input: Use the privacy-safe three-event intake contract rather than publishing confidential raw logs.
